card.title: Email
card.showAll: Show all emails to this recipient
card.linkHidden: Link hidden. Links with tokens (password reset, confirmation, invitation) work like a password, so the log does not keep them. The button in the email does nothing here.
card.rerendered: The email is redrawn with the current template: email texts or layout changed since it was sent. The subject above is the one that was sent.
card.noteHidden: The sender's message is not kept in the log.
card.templateGone: This email type no longer exists in this Studio version, so it cannot be shown.

notFound.title: Email not found
notFound.body: Its record was deleted after the retention period, or the email number in the address is wrong.

next.title: What you can do
next.reset_password: The link in the email is single-use and not kept in the log. Issue a new one in Users: the person's card, "Issue password reset link". Or ask the person to click "Forgot password" again.
next.verify_email: The person can request the email again on the sign-in page: "Send the link again".
next.invite: Send the invitation again in Users, Invitations tab: the old link stops working.
next.email_change: The person repeats the address change in their account settings.
next.project_invitation_link: A project member who can invite may send it again: Access, "Resend".
next.inbox: The notification is in the recipient's Inbox, the email only duplicates it.
next.notice: This is a notice about an account action: the action itself is done, there is no need to repeat the email.
next.smtp_test: Send the test email again in the Mail (SMTP) block.
next.smtpOff: Mail was not set up, so the email was not sent. It will not go out by itself after setup either.
next.suppressed: The email was not sent: {{reason}}. This is not a failure, the Studio works this way.
